"""Add a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf using reportlab + pypdf."""
import datetime
import io
import os

from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

REPORT = "report.pdf"
TEMP = "report_with_cover.pdf"
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"

# 1. Build the cover page in memory with reportlab
date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
print(f"Current date string: {date_str}")

buf = io.BytesIO()
c = canvas.Canvas(buf, pagesize=letter)
width, height = letter

c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 + 50, TITLE)

c.setStrokeColorRGB(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
c.setLineWidth(1)
c.line(width / 2 - 150, height / 2 + 20, width / 2 + 150, height / 2 + 20)

c.setFont("Helvetica", 18)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 - 30, date_str)

c.showPage()
c.save()
buf.seek(0)

# 2. Prepend the cover page to the report
cover_reader = PdfReader(buf)
report_reader = PdfReader(REPORT)
original_pages = len(report_reader.pages)
print(f"Original report pages: {original_pages}")

writer = PdfWriter()
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
for page in report_reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open(TEMP, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)
print(f"Wrote merged draft: {TEMP}")

# 3. Validate the merged draft
merged = PdfReader(TEMP)
assert len(merged.pages) == original_pages + 1, "Unexpected page count"
first_text = merged.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
assert TITLE in first_text, "Title not found on cover page"
assert date_str in first_text, "Date not found on cover page"
print("Validation OK: cover contains title and date; page count matches.")

# 4. Replace report.pdf with the merged document
os.replace(TEMP, REPORT)
print(f"Updated {REPORT} with cover page prepended.")

import importlib

mods = [
    "pypdf",
    "PyPDF2",
    "reportlab",
    "fpdf",
    "pdfplumber",
    "fitz",
    "PIL",
    "img2pdf",
    "cairo",
]

for m in mods:
    try:
        mod = importlib.import_module(m)
        version = getattr(mod, "__version__", "unknown")
        print(f"{m}: AVAILABLE ({version})")
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"{m}: missing ({type(exc).__name__})")

import shutil
import subprocess

tools = [
    "qpdf",
    "pdftk",
    "gs",
    "ps2pdf",
    "pdfunite",
    "pdftotext",
    "pdfinfo",
    "mutool",
    "pdftoppm",
    "pdfimages",
    "enscript",
    "a2ps",
    "python3",
    "node",
]

for t in tools:
    path = shutil.which(t)
    if path is None:
        print(f"{t}: NOT FOUND")
        continue
    try:
        out = subprocess.run(
            [t, "--version"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10
        )
        detail = (out.stdout or out.stderr).strip().splitlines()
        print(f"{t}: {path} | {detail[0] if detail else 'ok'}")
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"{t}: {path} | error: {exc}")

"""Inspect the structure of report.pdf with stdlib only."""

import re

DATA = open("report.pdf", "rb").read()
print(f"File size: {len(DATA)} bytes")
print(f"Header: {DATA[:16]!r}")

m = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", DATA)
print(f"startxref marker: {m.group(1).decode() if m else None}")

# Locate trailer
trailer_match = re.search(rb"trailer\s*(<<.*?>>)\s*startxref", DATA, re.S)
if trailer_match:
    print(f"trailer dict: {trailer_match.group(1).decode('latin-1')}")

# Parse the classic xref table
xref_match = re.search(rb"xref\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s*((?:\d{10} \d{5} [nf] \r?\n)+)", DATA)
if xref_match:
    first, count, entries_blob = (
        int(xref_match.group(1)),
        int(xref_match.group(2)),
        xref_match.group(3),
    )
    entries = re.findall(rb"(\d{10}) (\d{5}) ([nf])", entries_blob)
    print(f"xref subsection: first={first} count={count} parsed={len(entries)}")
    offsets = {}
    for i, (off, gen, kind) in enumerate(entries):
        num = first + i
        offsets[num] = (int(off), int(gen), kind.decode())
        if num == 0:
            continue
        start = DATA.find(f"{num} 0 obj".encode(), int(off))
        end = DATA.find(b"endobj", start)
        raw = DATA[start:end] if start != -1 and end != -1 else b""
        # summarize
        head = raw[:200].decode("latin-1").replace("\n", " ")
        print(f"  obj {num} (off={off.decode()}, gen={gen.decode()}, {kind.decode()}): {head}")
    print(f"Object numbers found: {sorted(offsets)}")
else:
    print("No classic xref table found (may be xref stream).")
    # try to find all objects anyway
    for mnum in re.finditer(rb"(?m)^(\d+) 0 obj", DATA):
        print(f"  obj at {mnum.start()}: {mnum.group(1).decode()}")

"""Add a cover page to report.pdf using only the Python standard library.

Builds a one-page cover PDF (title + current date) by hand, then merges it
before the existing report pages by rewriting the /Pages tree and appending
the new cover objects. The result replaces report.pdf in place.
"""

import datetime
import os
import re

REPORT = "report.pdf"
TEMP = "report_with_cover.pdf"
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"

PAGE_W, PAGE_H = 612, 792  # US Letter

# --- Helvetica-Bold glyph widths (1/1000 em), used to center the text ---
HB_WIDTHS = {
    "A": 722, "B": 722, "C": 722, "D": 722, "E": 667, "F": 667, "G": 778,
    "H": 722, "I": 278, "J": 556, "K": 722, "L": 611, "M": 833, "N": 722,
    "O": 778, "P": 667, "Q": 778, "R": 722, "S": 667, "T": 611, "U": 722,
    "V": 667, "W": 944, "X": 667, "Y": 667, "Z": 611,
    "a": 667, "b": 611, "c": 556, "d": 611, "e": 556, "f": 333, "g": 611,
    "h": 611, "i": 278, "j": 278, "k": 556, "l": 278, "m": 833, "n": 722,
    "o": 722, "p": 611, "q": 611, "r": 556, "s": 556, "t": 333, "u": 722,
    "v": 667, "w": 944, "x": 667, "y": 667, "z": 611,
    " ": 278, ",": 278, ".": 278, "-": 333,
    "0": 556, "1": 278, "2": 556, "3": 556, "4": 556, "5": 556,
    "6": 556, "7": 556, "8": 556, "9": 556,
}
HELVETICA_WIDTHS = dict(HB_WIDTHS)
HELVETICA_WIDTHS.update({  # Helvetica (regular) widths for the date line
    "A": 667, "B": 667, "C": 722, "D": 722, "E": 667, "F": 611, "G": 778,
    "H": 722, "I": 278, "J": 500, "K": 667, "L": 556, "M": 833, "N": 722,
    "O": 778, "P": 667, "Q": 778, "R": 722, "S": 667, "T": 611, "U": 722,
    "V": 667, "W": 944, "X": 667, "Y": 667, "Z": 611,
    "a": 556, "b": 556, "c": 500, "d": 556, "e": 556, "f": 278, "g": 556,
    "h": 556, "i": 222, "j": 222, "k": 500, "l": 222, "m": 833, "n": 556,
    "o": 556, "p": 556, "q": 556, "r": 333, "s": 500, "t": 278, "u": 556,
    "v": 500, "w": 722, "x": 500, "y": 500, "z": 500,
})


def text_width(text, size, widths):
    total = sum(widths.get(ch, 556) for ch in text)
    return total * size / 1000.0


def centered_x(text, size, widths):
    return (PAGE_W - text_width(text, size, widths)) / 2.0


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Build the cover content stream (pure ASCII PDF operators)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
print(f"Current date: {date_str}")

title_x = centered_x(TITLE, 30, HB_WIDTHS)
date_x = centered_x(date_str, 18, HELVETICA_WIDTHS)

cover_stream = (
    "BT\n"
    "/F1 30 Tf\n"
    f"{title_x:.2f} 470 Td\n"
    f"({TITLE}) Tj\n"
    "ET\n"
    "BT\n"
    "/F1 18 Tf\n"
    f"{date_x:.2f} 420 Td\n"
    f"({date_str}) Tj\n"
    "ET\n"
).encode("latin-1")

cover_page_num = 9
font_num = 10
stream_num = 11

cover_page = (
    f"<< /Type /Page /Parent 7 0 R /MediaBox [ 0 0 {PAGE_W} {PAGE_H} ] "
    f"/Resources << /Font << /F1 {font_num} 0 R >> /ProcSet [ /PDF /Text ] >> "
    f"/Contents {stream_num} 0 R >>"
).encode("latin-1")

cover_font = (
    b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold "
    b"/Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding >>"
)

cover_stream_obj = (
    b"<< /Length " + str(len(cover_stream)).encode() + b" >>\n"
    b"stream\n" + cover_stream + b"\nendstream"
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Parse the original report.pdf (classic xref table)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
data = open(REPORT, "rb").read()

xref_m = re.search(rb"xref\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s*((?:\d{10} \d{5} [nf] \r?\n)+)", data)
assert xref_m, "report.pdf does not use a classic xref table"
first_obj, count = int(xref_m.group(1)), int(xref_m.group(2))
entries = re.findall(rb"(\d{10}) \d{5} ([nf])", xref_m.group(3))
assert count == len(entries) and first_obj == 0, "unexpected xref layout"

offsets = {i: int(off) for i, (off, kind) in enumerate(entries)}
max_obj = max(offsets)
assert cover_page_num == max_obj + 1, f"expected next object number {cover_page_num}"

raw_objects = {}
for num in range(1, max_obj + 1):
    start = data.find(f"{num} 0 obj".encode(), offsets[num])
    assert start != -1, f"object {num} not found at claimed offset"
    end = data.find(b"endobj", start)
    assert end != -1, f"object {num} has no endobj"
    raw_objects[num] = data[start : end + len(b"endobj")]

# Sanity checks on the structure we expect
pages_raw = raw_objects[7]
assert b"/Type /Pages" in pages_raw and b"/Count 1" in pages_raw
assert re.search(rb"/Kids\s*\[\s*4 0 R\s*\]", pages_raw), "unexpected /Kids"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Rewrite the Pages object to include the cover page first
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
pages_new = re.sub(rb"/Count\s+\d+", b"/Count 2", pages_raw)
pages_new = re.sub(
    rb"/Kids\s*\[", f"/Kids [ {cover_page_num} 0 R ".encode(), pages_new, count=1
)
assert pages_new != pages_raw

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Assemble the merged PDF with a fresh xref table
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
parts = []
header = b"%PDF-1.4\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n"
parts.append(header)

body_offsets = {}
for num in range(1, max_obj + 1):
    body = raw_objects[num] if num != 7 else pages_new
    body_offsets[num] = len(b"".join(parts))
    parts.append(f"{num} 0 obj\n".encode() + body + b"\n")

for num, body in ((cover_page_num, cover_page), (font_num, cover_font), (stream_num, cover_stream_obj)):
    body_offsets[num] = len(b"".join(parts))
    parts.append(f"{num} 0 obj\n".encode() + body + b"\n")

new_size = max_obj + 4  # objects 0..(max_obj+3)
xref_offset = len(b"".join(parts))
xref_lines = ["xref\n", f"0 {new_size}\n", "0000000000 65535 f \n"]
for num in range(1, new_size):
    xref_lines.append(f"{body_offsets[num]:010d} 00000 n \n")

trailer_id = re.search(rb"/ID\s*\[(<[0-9A-Fa-f]+>)(<[0-9A-Fa-f]+>)\]", data)
id_part = (
    f"/ID [{trailer_id.group(1).decode()}{trailer_id.group(2).decode()}]"
    if trailer_id
    else ""
)
trailer = (
    f"trailer\n<< /Size {new_size} /Root 5 0 R /Info 6 0 R {id_part} >>\n"
    f"startxref\n{xref_offset}\n%%EOF\n"
)

merged = b"".join(parts) + "".join(xref_lines).encode("latin-1") + trailer.encode("latin-1")

with open(TEMP, "wb") as f:
    f.write(merged)
print(f"Wrote merged draft: {TEMP} ({len(merged)} bytes)")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Structural validation of the merged file
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def parse_xref(blob):
    m = re.search(rb"xref\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s*((?:\d{10} \d{5} [nf] \r?\n)+)", blob)
    assert m
    es = re.findall(rb"(\d{10}) \d{5} ([nf])", m.group(3))
    return {i: int(off) for i, (off, k) in enumerate(es)}


m_offsets = parse_xref(merged)
assert len(m_offsets) == new_size, "xref size mismatch"
for num in range(1, new_size):
    start = merged.find(f"{num} 0 obj".encode(), m_offsets[num])
    assert start == m_offsets[num], f"object {num} offset mismatch"

# Pages tree
pages_obj = merged[merged.find(b"7 0 obj"):]
assert b"/Count 2" in pages_obj
assert b"/Kids [ 9 0 R 4 0 R ]" in pages_obj
print("Pages tree OK: /Count 2, /Kids [ 9 0 R 4 0 R ]")

# Cover page objects
cover_start = merged.find(b"9 0 obj", m_offsets[9])
cover_body = merged[cover_start: merged.find(b"endobj", cover_start)]
assert b"/Parent 7 0 R" in cover_body and b"/Contents 11 0 R" in cover_body
print("Cover page object OK")

stream_start = merged.find(b"stream\n", m_offsets[11]) + len(b"stream\n")
stream_end = merged.find(b"\nendstream", stream_start)
stream_data = merged[stream_start:stream_end]
assert TITLE.encode() in stream_data, "title missing from cover stream"
assert date_str.encode() in stream_data, "date missing from cover stream"
print("Cover text OK: title and date present in content stream")

# Original content preserved
orig_8 = raw_objects[8]
idx = merged.find(b"8 0 obj", m_offsets[8])
end = merged.find(b"endobj", idx)
assert merged[idx : end + 6] == orig_8, "original content object altered"
print("Original report content stream preserved byte-for-byte")

print("All structural checks passed.")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Replace report.pdf with the merged document
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
os.replace(TEMP, REPORT)
print(f"Updated {REPORT} with cover page prepended.")

"""Add a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf using reportlab + pypdf."""
import datetime
import io
import os

from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

REPORT = "report.pdf"
TEMP = "report_with_cover.pdf"
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"

# 1. Build the cover page in memory with reportlab
date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
print(f"Current date string: {date_str}")

buf = io.BytesIO()
c = canvas.Canvas(buf, pagesize=letter)
width, height = letter

c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 + 50, TITLE)

c.setStrokeColorRGB(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
c.setLineWidth(1)
c.line(width / 2 - 150, height / 2 + 20, width / 2 + 150, height / 2 + 20)

c.setFont("Helvetica", 18)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height / 2 - 30, date_str)

c.showPage()
c.save()
buf.seek(0)

# 2. Prepend the cover page to the report
cover_reader = PdfReader(buf)
report_reader = PdfReader(REPORT)
original_pages = len(report_reader.pages)
print(f"Original report pages: {original_pages}")

writer = PdfWriter()
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
for page in report_reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open(TEMP, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)
print(f"Wrote merged draft: {TEMP}")

# 3. Validate the merged draft
merged = PdfReader(TEMP)
assert len(merged.pages) == original_pages + 1, "Unexpected page count"
first_text = merged.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
assert TITLE in first_text, "Title not found on cover page"
assert date_str in first_text, "Date not found on cover page"
print("Validation OK: cover contains title and date; page count matches.")

# 4. Replace report.pdf with the merged document
os.replace(TEMP, REPORT)
print(f"Updated {REPORT} with cover page prepended.")

import importlib

mods = [
    "pypdf",
    "PyPDF2",
    "reportlab",
    "fpdf",
    "pdfplumber",
    "fitz",
    "PIL",
    "img2pdf",
    "cairo",
]

for m in mods:
    try:
        mod = importlib.import_module(m)
        version = getattr(mod, "__version__", "unknown")
        print(f"{m}: AVAILABLE ({version})")
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"{m}: missing ({type(exc).__name__})")

import shutil
import subprocess

tools = [
    "qpdf",
    "pdftk",
    "gs",
    "ps2pdf",
    "pdfunite",
    "pdftotext",
    "pdfinfo",
    "mutool",

]

    try:

"""Inspect the structure of report.pdf with stdlib only."""

import re

DATA = open("report.pdf", "rb").read()
print(f"File size: {len(DATA)} bytes")
print(f"Header: {DATA[:16]!r}")

m = re.search(rb"startxref\s+(\d+)", DATA)
print(f"startxref marker: {m.group(1).decode() if m else None}")

# Locate trailer
trailer_match = re.search(rb"trailer\s*(<<.*?>>)\s*startxref", DATA, re.S)
if trailer_match:
    print(f"trailer dict: {trailer_match.group(1).decode('latin-1')}")

# Parse the classic xref table
xref_match = re.search(rb"xref\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s*((?:\d{10} \d{5} [nf] \r?\n)+)", DATA)
if xref_match:
    first, count, entries_blob = (
        int(xref_match.group(1)),
        int(xref_match.group(2)),
        xref_match.group(3),
    )
    entries = re.findall(rb"(\d{10}) (\d{5}) ([nf])", entries_blob)
    print(f"xref subsection: first={first} count={count} parsed={len(entries)}")
    offsets = {}
    for i, (off, gen, kind) in enumerate(entries):
        num = first + i
        offsets[num] = (int(off), int(gen), kind.decode())
        if num == 0:
            continue
        start = DATA.find(f"{num} 0 obj".encode(), int(off))
        end = DATA.find(b"endobj", start)
        raw = DATA[start:end] if start != -1 and end != -1 else b""
        # summarize
        head = raw[:200].decode("latin-1").replace("\n", " ")
        print(f"  obj {num} (off={off.decode()}, gen={gen.decode()}, {kind.decode()}): {head}")
    print(f"Object numbers found: {sorted(offsets)}")

    print("No classic xref table found (may be xref stream).")
    # try to find all objects anyway
    for mnum in re.finditer(rb"(?m)^(\d+) 0 obj", DATA):
        print(f"  obj at {mnum.start()}: {mnum.group(1).decode()}")

assert b"/Type /Pages" in pages_raw and b"/Count 1" in pages_raw
assert re.search(rb"/Kids\s*\[\s*4 0 R\s*\]", pages_raw), "unexpected /Kids"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Rewrite the Pages object to include the cover page first
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
pages_new = re.sub(rb"/Count\s+\d+", b"/Count 2", pages_raw)
pages_new = re.sub(
    rb"/Kids\s*\[", f"/Kids [ {cover_page_num} 0 R ".encode(), pages_new, count=1
)
assert pages_new != pages_raw and b"endobj" in pages_new

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Assemble the merged PDF with a fresh xref table
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
parts = [b"%PDF-1.4\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n"]

body_offsets = {}
for num in range(1, max_obj + 1):
    obj_text = raw_objects[num] if num != 7 else pages_new
    body_offsets[num] = len(b"".join(parts))
    parts.append(obj_text + b"\n")

for num, body in (
    (cover_page_num, cover_page),
    (font_num, cover_font),
    (stream_num, cover_stream_obj),
):
    body_offsets[num] = len(b"".join(parts))
    parts.append(f"{num} 0 obj\n".encode() + body + b"\nendobj\n")

new_size = max_obj + 4  # objects 0..(max_obj+3)
xref_offset = len(b"".join(parts))
xref_lines = ["xref\n", f"0 {new_size}\n", "0000000000 65535 f \n"]
for num in range(1, new_size):
    xref_lines.append(f"{body_offsets[num]:010d} 00000 n \n")

trailer_id = re.search(rb"/ID\s*\[(<[0-9A-Fa-f]+>)(<[0-9A-Fa-f]+>)\]", data)
id_part = (
    f"/ID [{trailer_id.group(1).decode()}{trailer_id.group(2).decode()}]"
    if trailer_id
    else ""
)
trailer = (
    f"trailer\n<< /Size {new_size} /Root 5 0 R /Info 6 0 R {id_part} >>\n"
    f"startxref\n{xref_offset}\n%%EOF\n"
)

merged = b"".join(parts) + "".join(xref_lines).encode("latin-1") + trailer.encode("latin-1")

with open(TEMP, "wb") as f:
    f.write(merged)
print(f"Wrote merged draft: {TEMP} ({len(merged)} bytes)")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Structural validation of the merged file
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def parse_xref(blob):
    m = re.search(rb"xref\s+(\d+)\s+(\d+)\s*((?:\d{10} \d{5} [nf] \r?\n)+)", blob)
    assert m
    es = re.findall(rb"(\d{10}) \d{5} ([nf])", m.group(3))
    return {i: int(off) for i, (off, k) in enumerate(es)}


m_offsets = parse_xref(merged)
assert len(m_offsets) == new_size, "xref size mismatch"
for num in range(1, new_size):
    start = merged.find(f"{num} 0 obj".encode(), m_offsets[num])
    assert start == m_offsets[num], f"object {num} offset mismatch"
print("xref table OK: all object offsets resolve")

# Pages tree
pages_obj = merged[m_offsets[7] : merged.find(b"endobj", m_offsets[7])]
assert b"/Count 2" in pages_obj
assert re.search(rb"/Kids\s*\[\s*9 0 R\s+4 0 R\s*\]", pages_obj), pages_obj
print("Pages tree OK: /Count 2, /Kids [ 9 0 R 4 0 R ]")

# Cover page objects
cover_start = merged.find(b"9 0 obj", m_offsets[9])
cover_body = merged[cover_start : merged.find(b"endobj", cover_start)]
assert b"/Parent 7 0 R" in cover_body and b"/Contents 11 0 R" in cover_body
print("Cover page object OK")

stream_start = merged.find(b"stream\n", m_offsets[11]) + len(b"stream\n")
stream_end = merged.find(b"\nendstream", stream_start)
stream_data = merged[stream_start:stream_end]
assert TITLE.encode() in stream_data, "title missing from cover stream"
assert date_str.encode() in stream_data, "date missing from cover stream"
print("Cover text OK: title and date present in content stream")

# Original content preserved
orig_8 = raw_objects[8]
idx = merged.find(b"8 0 obj", m_offsets[8])
end = merged.find(b"endobj", idx)
assert merged[idx : end + len(b"endobj")] == orig_8, "original content object altered"
print("Original report content stream preserved byte-for-byte")

print("All structural checks passed.")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
os.replace(TEMP, REPORT)
print(f"Updated {REPORT} with cover page prepended.")
